notes.title: Major Update – BOT.vinnik Championships Trilogy
notes.content:
Hello comrades!


We’ve just deployed a major update across all three BOT.vinnik Soviet Championship titles (Early, Mid-Century, and Late USSR). Our grumpy mentor has been polished up, and the games are running smoother than ever.

Here’s what’s new:

🔊 New BOT.vinnik Reactions
We imported all the updated reactions straight from our upcoming game, BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy. The professor now responds to your moves (whether brilliant or disastrous) with even sharper sarcasm and personality.

🖥️ Windowed Mode
No more being trapped in fullscreen! You can now freely toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode with a simple ALT + ENTER.

📈 Gameplay Flow Improvements
Clicking confusion begone! We clarified when clicks are actually needed to proceed.

🎨 Minor Visual Refinements
Subtle tweaks around the chessboard for a cleaner and sharper look.

🚀 New Splash Screen
Now featuring our updated Deep Green Games studio branding.
[hr][/hr]
We’re thrilled to bring these improvements to the trilogy — and this is just a warm-up.
👉 Don’t forget to add BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy to your wishlist! That’s where our sarcastic professor truly shines.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy?snr=1_5_9_"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: The BOT.VINNIK you’ve been waiting for is finally here!
notes.content:
Hello, comrades!

You may have noticed we’ve been radio silent for a while—but there’s a good reason: we’ve spent the last few years working on the most ambitious BOT.VINNIK project to date!

🎉 BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy is now live on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/

This new game is the culmination of everything we’ve learned from the previous titles in the series. Alongside a brand-new visual style, it features:


 A reworked scoring system

 Structured progression across lessons

 Multiple difficulty levels

 A growing platform powered by future DLCs

 And even a beginner mode for those who don’t know how the knight moves yet


Of course, BOT.VINNIK’s trademark sarcasm and brutal honesty are back and sharper than ever.

A free demo will be released soon — until then, check out the trailer and hit that Wishlist button to let BOT.VINNIK know you’re still worthy of being called "comrade."
(YouTube™ embed: “BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy – Reveal Trailer”)

Thanks for all the support over the years!
See you at the Academy.


Rodrigo & Eduardo
Deep Green Games
